name: Anarkhicheskoye leto
source:
Some punk guy named Nikita, after a heated punk concert by the band GrOb, goes out to the nearest grocery store, where he gets beaten the fuck up, and by a strange coincidence, travels through time and ends up near the gates of a pioneer camp with the Soviet-style name Sovyonok. Inside the camp, our protagonist does fucked up shit, gets wasted, and causes anarchy.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1741238519]Steam[/url]]
